description: The commencement gate for the Motor Vehicle Act -> Traffic Safety Act transition. The quiz engine reads `activeLawVersion` and will only serve questions whose lawVersion matches an entry marked inForce. Promoting Traffic Safety Act content is a deliberate, reviewed edit to this file — never an automatic consequence of a crawler noticing a source change or of the calendar year advancing.

lawVersions.title: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.N.S. 1989, c. 293

evidence.observation: Consolidated statute published by the Office of the Legislative Counsel, consolidation footer dated MAY 1, 2026.

lawVersions.note: The operative traffic statute in Nova Scotia. All `current` questions are written against this.

lawVersions.title: Traffic Safety Act, S.N.S. 2025, c. 20

evidence.observation: Proclamations of Nova Scotia Statutes lists: "Traffic Safety Act / 2025, c. 20 -- NOT PROCLAIMED IN FORCE". The Department of Public Works page (ns-tsa-changes-page) separately instructs readers to "Continue to follow the Motor Vehicle Act until then."

lawVersions.note: Royal Assent in October 2025 does NOT bring the Act into force. Questions carrying lawVersion "tsa-2025" must have legalStatus "future" and are excluded from every practice and mock-test pool.

lawVersions.title: Traffic Safety Act, S.N.S. 2018, c. 29
lawVersions.note: An earlier Traffic Safety Act that was never proclaimed. Recorded so that its existence is not mistaken for commencement of the 2025 Act.

promotionChecklist: Confirm on the Proclamations of Nova Scotia Statutes page that the Act (or the specific sections) are proclaimed in force, with a date.
Confirm the Order in Council / Royal Gazette Part II entry that effects the proclamation.
Confirm the Government of Nova Scotia guidance page no longer says to continue following the Motor Vehicle Act.

Only then set inForce/inForceSince for the law version, change activeLawVersion, and move affected questions from `future` to `current` and the displaced ones to `superseded` with an effectiveTo date.
Run `pnpm content:validate` and `pnpm test` before shipping.
